tax.text: Biss calls for a wealth tax on billionaires and reversing corporate tax cuts to fund public programs.
tax.quote: Implement a modest wealth tax on the assets of billionaires and ultra-millionaires

wages.text: Biss supports raising the minimum wage and protecting workers' right to organize.
wages.quote: We must raise the minimum wage, protect workers' right to organize and end Trump's tariffs.

trade.text: Biss opposes Trump's tariffs and wants Americans protected from tariffs that raise costs on working people.
trade.quote: We must also ensure that Americans are protected from expensive tariffs that most affect working people

debt.text: Biss opposes cuts to Social Security and Medicare and wants to expand benefits.
debt.quote: Congress hasn't expanded Social Security benefits in more than 50 years

housing.text: Biss says the government should remove barriers to building and reward pro-housing zoning like legalizing apartments near transit.
housing.quote: If we want to lower housing costs, we need to build more homes.

schools.text: Biss says the country has underfunded public schools and calls for greater investment in them.
schools.quote: America has failed to adequately invest in our public school system for decades.

immigration.text: Biss calls to abolish ICE and create a fair path to citizenship.
immigration.quote: It is abhorrent and anti-American to see ICE agents disappearing people into detention centers or deporting them to danger.

guns.text: Biss supports universal background checks on all gun sales.
guns.quote: Every gun sale — whether at a store, a gun show, or online — should require a background check.

abortion.text: Biss wants Congress to codify the right to abortion into law.
abortion.quote: Congress should have codified the right to an abortion long ago

gender.text: Biss defends trans people and supports passing the Equality Act.
gender.quote: The attacks on trans people are dangerous and disgraceful.

health.text: Biss supports a national single-payer system, Medicare for All.
health.quote: It's expensive, impossible to navigate, and doesn't lead to better health outcomes. We need to pass Medicare for All

energy.text: Biss says the country is already experiencing the catastrophic effects of climate change.
energy.quote: we're already experiencing the catastrophic effects of climate change.

voting.text: Biss wants to restore Voting Rights Act protections and stop voter suppression laws.
voting.quote: We must fully reinstate protections gutted by the Supreme Court and prevent voter suppression laws from taking effect.

tax.text: Elleson calls for pro-growth tax and regulatory policies so workers keep more of their pay and businesses face less red tape.
tax.quote: restore pro-growth tax and regulatory policies that let workers keep more of their paychecks

trade.text: Elleson backs targeted tariffs to counter unfair trade practices and intellectual property theft, citing China.
trade.quote: the use of targeted tariffs to push back against unfair trade practices and intellectual property theft

safety.text: Elleson backs funding law enforcement while emphasizing training rooted in de-escalation and community trust.
safety.quote: Support law enforcement with resources and training rooted in de-escalation and community trust

immigration.text: Elleson supports strong border security and enforcing immigration law, focusing resources on removing those who pose public safety threats.
immigration.quote: focus federal resources on removing individuals who pose real public safety threats

guns.text: Elleson says gun ownership is protected by the Second Amendment and favors enforcing existing laws over broad new restrictions.
guns.quote: enforcement of existing laws, and preventing illegal firearms, rather than broad restrictions on law-abiding citizens

abortion.text: Elleson says elective abortion should be very rare because unborn life has inherent value, with exceptions for the mother's life, rape, or incest.
abortion.quote: Elective abortion should be very rare because unborn human life has inherent value and deserves protection.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Elleson says attempts to physically or socially transition a child to the opposite sex constitute child abuse.
gender.quote: Attempts to physically or socially transition a child to the opposite sex constitute child abuse.

health.text: Elleson says Medicaid and Medicare should remain but opposes creating additional taxpayer-funded coverage programs.
health.quote: Medicaid and Medicare should remain available, but no other taxpayer-funded programs are necessary.

energy.text: Elleson favors expanding domestic oil, gas, coal, and nuclear power for reliability and energy independence.
energy.quote: Fossil fuels like natural gas, coal, and oil, along with nuclear power, are the most reliable sources to meet growing electricity demand and support energy independence.

voting.text: Elleson strongly disagreed with the statement that people should be able to vote without photo identification, indicating support for voter ID.
voting.quote: People should be able to vote without photo identification
